rules.title: Tax and legal persons
rules.text: IS replaces IBIC and IMF. Capital companies, including a single-member SARL, fall within IS; classify other entities under arts. 2–4 before computing.
rules.quote: cet impôt, désigné sous le nom d’impôt sur les sociétés (IS), remplace
rules.assessment: Read CGI 1-4: IS replacement and capital/SARL scope supported; GIE exemption/member allocation remains a classification instruction, not a blanket company assessment.

rules.title: Territorial business profits
rules.text: Use profits of enterprises operated in Mauritania and profits allocated by a double-tax agreement. Residence means registered office or effective management in Mauritania; nonresident enterprises with a local permanent establishment are included.
rules.quote: dont le siège social ou le lieu de direction effective est situé en Mauritanie
rules.assessment: Read CGI 5 with 6: resident seat/effective management and nonresident PE, territorial enterprise profits and treaty allocation supported.

rules.title: Normal regime
rules.text: Annual turnover excluding tax above MRU 5,000,000 brings the normal real regime. Prorate the limit for a start or cessation during the year; a fall below the limit needs two consecutive years before moving down.
rules.quote: supérieur à cinq millions (5.000.000) d’Ouguiya
rules.assessment: Read 44 with 43, 45-48: strict greater-than 5 m, two consecutive below years and time apportionment supported.

rules.title: Intermediate regime
rules.text: A company at or below MRU 5,000,000 annual turnover excluding tax uses the intermediate real regime, subject to the normal-regime transition rule. Crossing above moves it to normal the following year.
rules.quote: inférieur ou égale à cinq millions (5.000.000) d’Ouguiya
rules.assessment: Read 46-48: ordinary threshold/next-year transition supported, but valid normal-regime election under 47 is omitted. F 1.

rules.title: Normal IS calculation
rules.text: For an ordinary normal-regime company, compare 25% of taxable net profit, 2% of taxable products under art. 8 excluding transfers and reversals of charges, and the MRU 100,000 minimum. Pay the greatest before credits. This is not a universal 2.5% turnover formula.
rules.quote: l’impôt sur les sociétés dû est égal à 25 % du bénéfice net imposable ou à 2 %
rules.assessment: Read 51(1) visually with 50-52: 25%, 2%, 100000 normal floor supported; MAI, margin/fisheries/transport special cases outside ordinary scope.

rules.title: Intermediate IS calculation
rules.text: Compare 25% of taxable net profit with 2.5% of taxable products under art. 8 excluding transfers and reversals of charges. Do not import the normal-regime fixed minimum into this paragraph. Special art. 225 margin businesses need their separate base.
rules.quote: égal à 25 % du bénéfice net imposable ou à 2,5 % des produits imposables
rules.assessment: Read 51(2) visually: 25% versus 2.5%, no normal fixed floor in this paragraph; 225 margin exclusion acknowledged.

rules.title: Accounting bridge and rounding
rules.text: Start with the net result of all operations, including disposals, and reconcile net assets, contributions and withdrawals under art. 7. Round taxable net profit or taxable products down to the nearest MRU 10. Art. 8 products use the accrued-right principle.
rules.quote: est arrondi à la dizaine d’Ouguiya inférieure
rules.assessment: Read 7-9 and 48: net-asset bridge, accruing products and down-to 10 rounding supported; intermediate computation requires 48 exclusions. F 1.

rules.title: Ordinary deductible expenses
rules.text: Expenses must serve the business, be real, documented with a regular invoice or import declaration bearing the supplier NIF, be booked as expenses, reduce net assets, not create exempt income and belong to the period. The later 2026 replacement of art. 14 needs its commencement resolved before this baseline can support a filing.
rules.quote: L’absence de la mention du numéro d’identification fiscale (NIF) du fournisseur
rules.assessment: Read 14 and 48: general expense/NIF/accounting tests supported; intermediate 48 restrictions omitted from the company Guide. F 1. Later 14 replacement held.

rules.title: Cash-payment exclusion
rules.text: An expense paid in cash to another business is not deductible where its unit amount exceeds MRU 200,000; the limit is MRU 50,000 for fishery-product exporting and processing businesses. Do not split a payment to assume deductibility.
rules.quote: leur montant unitaire excède 200.000 MRU
rules.assessment: Read 14(3) and adjacent 25: business-to-business cash expense unit limits 200000/50000 supported. No positive rule permitting artificial payment fragmentation stated.

rules.title: Accounting year
rules.text: Close accounts at 31 December. A new enterprise can close its first balance sheet at the following year-end, but must prepare a provisional operating account at the first 31 December, tax it immediately and deduct that tax from the first balance-sheet assessment.
rules.quote: arrêter chaque année leurs comptes à la date du 31 décembre
rules.assessment: Read 50 visually: year-end and first provisional-year rule supported, but explicit transfer/cessation exception in 50(3) omitted. F 3.

rules.title: Return and payment calendar
rules.text: Declare the previous 31 December result by 31 March. For ordinary normal/intermediate IS, pay 40% by 31 March, 30% by 30 June and the balance by 30 September of the following year, using the prescribed return and financial statements.
rules.quote: Il représente 40 % du montant de l’impôt sur les sociétés dû
rules.assessment: Read 58-60: ordinary normal/intermediate 40/30/balance on 31 March/30 June/30 September and 31 March declaration supported; special fisheries excluded.

rules.title: Return attachments
rules.text: Normal-regime attachments include prescribed annual financial statements and annexes, annual salary declaration, third-party fee declaration, partner/distribution declaration, depreciation/provision table and detailed rent schedule. Intermediate companies attach simplified prescribed financial statements and annexes. Both provide constitutional amendments where relevant and statutory-body minutes within seven months of closing.
rules.quote: dans les sept (7) mois de la clôture de l’exercice
rules.assessment: Read 61-62: listed ordinary/simplified attachments, constitutional amendments and seven-month minutes supported. This is not a complete supplier-report/audit implementation.

rules.title: Withholding credits
rules.text: IRCM and IRF withheld on income included in business profits are creditable against IS; unused credits carry forward. Credits relating to an IS exemption are definitively retained by the Treasury. Keep certificates and match income before claiming.
rules.quote: Lorsque le montant du crédit ne peut pas être imputé
rules.assessment: Read 53-54: included capital/property withholding credits, carryforward and exemption forfeiture supported.

rules.title: Privileged-tax jurisdictions
rules.text: Deducted payments to a recipient in a privileged-tax jurisdiction must be added back unless the enterprise proves a real transaction and an amount that is neither abnormal nor excessive. The comparison is tax payable less than half the ordinary Mauritanian equivalent, not a country-name blacklist.
rules.quote: des opérations réelles et ne présentent pas un caractère anormal ou exagéré
rules.assessment: Read 23 with 22 and 40: proof of real/nonexcessive transactions and no-tax/less-than-half-equivalent test supported; not a country-name blacklist.

rules.title: Annual filing sanctions
rules.text: The baseline LPF L.131(3) imposes 1% of tax-inclusive turnover for a missing/late annual return or mandatory document, with ordinary minimums MRU 50,000 normal and MRU 35,000 intermediate, and separate exempt/convention-company minimums MRU 150,000 and MRU 75,000. Confirm which failure is assessed; do not silently substitute a generic late-payment percentage.
rules.quote: 1 % du chiffre d’affaires toutes taxes comprises
rules.assessment: Read L 131(1)-(4), 158 visually: annual-return/document 1%tax-inclusive turnover and differentiated minima supported. Does not settle other breaches or the separate document-cure procedure.

rules.title: Recovery penalty trigger
rules.text: For a spontaneous-payment tax covered by a recovery notice, L.136(1) gives a 10% principal surcharge, counted from the fourth day after notification of that notice. It is not a daily interest rate or an automatic charge starting on the ordinary return due date.
rules.quote: à partir du quatrième jour suivant la notification de l’avis de mise
rules.assessment: Read L 136-139: 10%principal spontaneous-tax recovery-notice trigger and fourth-day timing supported; not daily interest.

rules.title: Separate individual business tax
rules.text: IBAPP taxes habitual own-account profit-making activity of natural persons and qualifying persons outside IS. Use Mauritanian profits and treaty allocations under art. 71, rather than applying one worldwide-income statement to every category of personal income.
rules.quote: en tenant compte uniquement des bénéfices réalisés en Mauritanie
rules.assessment: Read 68-72: habitual own-account profit, persons outside IS, Mauritanian profits/treaty allocation supported; 70 elections and 69 fishery exclusion are classification prerequisites.

rules.title: IBAPP regimes
rules.text: Normal applies above MRU 5,000,000 turnover excluding tax; intermediate from MRU 3,000,000 to MRU 5,000,000; forfait strictly below MRU 3,000,000. Importers cannot use forfait. Read two-year downward transitions, next-year normal transition, immediate forfait crossing, prorating and elections under arts. 73, 77–82.
rules.quote: Les importateurs ne peuvent pas relever du régime du forfait
rules.assessment: Read 73, 77-84: >5 m/3 m-5 m/<3 m, importer exclusion, transitions, proration/election references supported; no invented universal personal-income threshold.

rules.title: IBAPP real-regime computation
rules.text: Ordinary normal/intermediate IBAPP compares 30% of taxable profit with 2.5% of art. 8 taxable products excluding transfers/reversals of charges, then the respective MRU 125,000/MRU 75,000 minimum. Transport, art. 225 margin businesses, retail petroleum and artisanal fisheries have separate rules in art. 87(3), (4), (6).
rules.quote: cent vingt-cinq mille (125.000) Ouguiya
rules.assessment: Read 87(1)-(6): 30%, 2.5%, 125000/75000 floors and special transport/margin/petroleum/artisanal exceptions supported.

rules.title: Forfait computation
rules.text: Qualifying forfait taxpayers pay 3% of declared turnover using a DGI-issued or approved form by 31 March. Keep the receipts/expenses register under art. 84; this is not permission to treat an importer as forfait.
rules.quote: égal à 3 % du chiffre d’affaires déclaré au plus tard le 31 mars
rules.assessment: Read 81, 83-84, 88, 94: 3%declared turnover, 31 March and receipts/expenses register supported; importer prohibition retained.

rules.title: IBAPP tax base
rules.text: Art. 74 imports IS profit rules but excludes specified exchange gains/losses, head-office charges, gifts/subsidies, deferred depreciation in loss periods, accelerated/declining depreciation and provisions. Property in the business balance sheet can enter an irrevocable IRF election under art. 75, with related expenses no longer deductible from IBAPP.
rules.quote: les résultats imposables sont déterminés dans les conditions prévues en matière d’impôt sur les sociétés
rules.assessment: Read 74-75 with 80: IS baseline plus the six excluded deduction categories and irrevocable property IRF election supported.

rules.title: IBAPP filing and payments
rules.text: Declare by 31 March for the previous 31 December year. Ordinary real-regime IBAPP pays 40% by 31 March, 30% by 30 June and the balance by 30 September; forfait is fully payable when the return is delivered, by 31 March.
rules.quote: d’acquitter leur cotisation d’impôt sur les bénéfices d’affaires dès la remise de leur déclaration
rules.assessment: Read 90, 94-98: real 40/30/balance and forfait full payment on delivery by 31 March supported.

rules.title: Employment territorial scope
rules.text: ITS covers salary for work in Mauritania; it also covers a domiciled employee even where work or employer is abroad, and an employee domiciled abroad where the work is in Mauritania, subject to treaties. Fiscal domicile is a permanent home, or, without such a home, the centre of vital interests.
rules.quote: le centre de leurs intérêts vitaux
rules.assessment: Read 109-112 and visually 111: domicile/work nexus and permanent-home then vital-interests tests supported, subject treaties. No 183-day test invented.

rules.title: Employment base and exemption
rules.text: Use cash remuneration and salary supplements, art. 113 benefit-in-kind treatment, compulsory pension/social deductions and art. 110 exemptions. Art. 110(1)(c) excludes MRU 6,000 monthly remuneration before the art. 114 scale. The scale thresholds refer to the resulting taxable remuneration, not unadjusted gross salary.
rules.quote: un montant de six mille (6.000) Ouguiya par mois de la rémunération
rules.assessment: Read 109-114 visually 44-45: 6000 remuneration exemption deducted before scale; compulsory pension/social deductions and cash-only case supported. Actual benefit interaction held.

rules.title: ITS formulas
rules.text: After base adjustments, round taxable monthly remuneration RI down to MRU 10. If RI is at most 9,000, tax = RI × 15%; above 9,000 through 21,000, tax = RI × 25% minus 900; above 21,000, tax = RI × 40% minus 4,050. Fraction-month pay is prorated; nonmonthly pensions/annuities are converted to monthly.
rules.assessment: Read 114(1)-(6), including next page 46 visually: bands/formulas/rounding/proportion/monthly pension conversion supported, but 20%special personnel cap omitted. F 2.

rules.title: Employment exceptions
rules.text: Professional expense allowances other than housing, transport, responsibility and office allowances have a combined MRU 1,000 monthly exemption under art. 110(1)(b); family-related allocations and listed war/disability pensions have their own exemptions. Art. 110(4) exempts real-value benefits in kind not exceeding 20% of cash remuneration; art. 113 otherwise refers to 40% benefit inclusion. Obtain a category-by-category benefit reconciliation before using that interaction.
rules.quote: qui n’excèdent pas 20 % de la rémunération perçue
rules.assessment: Read 110 and 113 visually: 1000 professional allowances with excluded allowance types, family/pension exemption categories, 20%real benefit threshold and 40%benefit inclusion supported; unresolved interaction explicitly held.

rules.title: Salary withholding and annual schedule
rules.text: The payer withholds when paying and reports/remits by the 15th of the next month using the prescribed form with NIF, period, remuneration and total withholding. The annual per-beneficiary salary schedule is due in the first fifteen days of February; art. 117(2) sets MRU 200 per omission/inaccuracy.
rules.quote: dans les quinze premiers jours du mois de février de chaque année
rules.assessment: Read 115-117 visually 46: withholding on payment, next 15 th, prescribed signed form, annual first 15 February and 200 per omission supported.

rules.title: Foreign employer/direct payment
rules.text: An employee covered by art. 111(2)(a) declares and pays ITS on taxable income by the 15th of the month after receipt using the prescribed form at the Treasury accountant for their domicile. This is not a universal annual March salary return.
rules.quote: au plus tard le 15 du mois suivant leur perception
rules.assessment: Read 118 with 111(2)(a): domicile employee self-declaration/payment by following 15 th supported; not asserted as a universal annual salary return.

rules.title: Property income
rules.text: IRF applies to rent and covered property gains outside taxable business profit, subject to the art. 75 election. Ordinary rent base is rent accrued whether received or not; subletting uses the rent difference. Art. 102(4) exempts annual rental income at most MRU 6,000 only where it is exclusive of all other income. IRF is 10%; the ordinary rent declaration/payment is before 1 March.
rules.quote: Le taux de l’impôt sur les revenus fonciers est fixé à 10 %
rules.assessment: Read 99, 102-108: accrued rents/sublease difference, exclusive-other-income 6000 exemption, 10%, before 1 March supported; property gains/special withholding calendars outside ordinary rental case.

rules.title: CNSS covered workers and rates
rules.text: The supervising ministry identifies workers under the Labour/Maritime Labour Codes, state contract/nonpermanent personnel, vocational pupils, interns, apprentices, domestic, temporary and occasional workers. Its current CNSS page states employer 13%, employee 1%, on monthly pay capped at MRU 15,000 and not below the stated MRU 4,500 SMIG. Do not reuse the old 15% total or its inconsistent branch components.
rules.quote: Des cotisations patronales (13%) et ouvrière (1%).
rules.assessment: Read full ministry CNSS population/financing text and independently reopened live page: 13%employer, 1%employee, 15000 ceiling, 4500 floor supported as administrative guidance; old branch arithmetic not repeated.

rules.title: Private-sector CNAM scope
rules.text: For this decree, employees are Labour/Maritime Labour Code workers on indefinite employment contracts; private companies must be registered in the commercial register, affiliated to social security and hold a NIF. Do not extrapolate these rules to every short-term worker, public employee or self-employed person.
rules.quote: sur la base d’un contrat de travail à durée indéterminée
rules.assessment: Read decree 2012-261 all 1-10 and visuallyp 1: indefinite Labour/Maritime contracts/private company registration-social-NIF definitions supported.

rules.title: Private-sector CNAM computation
rules.text: Covered private-company employees contribute 4% and the employer 5%, based on all gross remuneration including allowances and bonuses. Private retirement pensions use 2.5% insured contribution. The decree states no CNSS-style wage ceiling for this base.
rules.quote: assises sur l’ensemble des rémunérations brutes perçues par les employés y compris les indemnités et primes.
rules.assessment: Read decree 4 table visually: 4%employee/5%employer, 2.5%private pension and gross allowances/bonuses supported; no ceiling in this text. Not claimed all-worker current law.

rules.title: CNAM payment
rules.text: Pay each monthly contribution by the 10th of the following month to a CNAM account at the Treasury or a national bank. Separate that date from the ITS 15th deadline; the CNSS remittance calendar is not established by this decree.
rules.quote: au plus tard le 10 du mois suivant
rules.assessment: Read decree 5 visually: monthly next 10 th, Treasury/national bank CNAM accounts supported; no imported CNSS due date.

rules.title: CNAM affiliation workflow
rules.text: The live CNAM procedure requires a company dossier including proof of the last quarter CNSS contribution and a company contact, deposited at the Cellule du Recouvrement. CNAM checks the dossier and registers the company/employees/dependants; its stated 14 working days is an estimate. Then declare employees and remit contributions.
rules.quote: Le dossier doit être déposé au niveau de la Cellule du Recouvrement
rules.assessment: Read CNAM actual steps 1-5: listed dossier, last-quarter CNSS payment, Cellule deposit, estimated 14 workingdays, registration/declaration/remittance supported. Application-to-DG remains a sensible workflow addition, not a supplied live form.

rules.title: Apprenticeship levy
rules.text: Real-regime IS/IBAPP employers owe apprenticeship tax at 0.60% of annual staff remuneration including benefits in kind, with the base rounded down to MRU 10. Qualifying apprenticeship relief is MRU 40 per apprentice present on 1 January under a regular contract, capped at 50% of the levy; discretionary education-related exemption needs application before 1 February.
rules.quote: Le taux de taxe est fixé à 0,60 %.
rules.assessment: Read 150-154, especially 57: real-regime employer 0.60%, annual staff pay incl benefits, rounding, 40 per eligible apprentice, 50%relief cap and discretionary-before 1 February supported.

rules.title: Apprenticeship calendar
rules.text: File the annual employer/base declaration before 1 February and pay by the declaration due date. A cessation, transfer or death triggers a declaration within 30 days. It is not a monthly 15th contribution.
rules.quote: chaque année, avant le 1
rules.assessment: Read 155-157: before 1 February declaration/payment and 30 days cessation/transfer/death supported, distinct from monthly payroll.

rules.title: Ordinary VAT scope
rules.text: VAT covers independent taxable operations under arts. 209–211. Ordinary authority to invoice VAT begins at annual turnover excluding tax of MRU 3,000,000 or more; importers are subject regardless of turnover. Below-threshold release requires two consecutive years below.
rules.quote: supérieur ou égal à 3.000.000 MRU
rules.assessment: Read 209-213 visually 72: independent taxable activity, >=3 m authorization, all importers andtwo-year decline supported.

rules.title: Threshold crossing
rules.text: If turnover crosses the limit during the year, VAT is due from the day of crossing. Notify DGI before the end of the following month; declare/pay VAT on the crossing month no later than the VAT for that following month. Do not charge retrospectively on every earlier sale solely because the year total exceeds the limit.
rules.quote: la taxe est due à compter du jour où s’est produit ce dépassement
rules.assessment: Read 211(3) visually: crossing day, followingmonth notification and crossing-month declaration no later than following-month return supported.

rules.title: Rates
rules.text: The ordinary rate is 16% and taxable-person exports of goods/services use 0%; the 2023 rectifying Act adds 18% for telephony. Zero rating preserves deduction subject to the deduction rules; exemption is a separate classification.
rules.article: CGI art. 230 as replaced by LFR2023 art. 3.1
rules.quote: Taux majoré : 18 % pour la téléphonie
rules.assessment: Read original 230 and replacement LFR 2023 physical 6/printed 4 visually: 16/18 telephony/0 taxable-person exports supported as cited replacement, not proven full 2026 chain.

rules.title: Supply location
rules.text: Goods are located where present at delivery, with the imported-goods and installed-goods rules in art. 217; real-property works are located where executed. Services are taxable where performed or, if performed abroad, used/exploited in Mauritania; export-service treatment and immovable/event exceptions require art. 219. Without proof of foreign location, art. 220 deems location Mauritania.
rules.quote: utilisée ou exploitée en Mauritanie, l’imposition est faite en Mauritanie
rules.assessment: Read 216-221: goods/import/install, works, service execution/use and exceptions/evidential presumption supported. Guide cross-border destination wrongly promises 221 mechanism. F 6.

rules.title: Exclusions and exemptions
rules.text: Art. 214 excludes operations subject to financial-operations tax/special insurance tax and, in the baseline text, nonresident services subject to art. 132 withholding. Art. 215 exempts specified medical/hospital services, approved education and listed foods with detailed conditions. Do not turn those lists into a universal basic-food or imported-service exemption. The 2026 digital-services changes need separate reconciliation.
rules.quote: les opérations soumises à la taxe sur les opérations financières
rules.assessment: Read 214-215 introductory exemptions: nonresident 132 exclusion, financial/insurance exclusions, medical/approvededucation/conditional foods supported. FullHS list held; 221 routing issue F 6.

rules.title: VAT point and cash/debit distinction
rules.text: For goods, follow delivery; imports become payable on release for consumption; services normally become payable on receipt of price/advances; works on execution or earlier receipt. Express DGI authorisation is needed for debit accounting, applying to all operations, from the next month; read its duration/revocation rules.
rules.quote: Pour les prestations de services, au moment de l’encaissement du prix ou des acomptes.
rules.assessment: Read 227-229: delivery/import-release, service receipt, works performance/earlier receipt and express debit-option whole-business/start supported. General duration/revocation explicitly referred to statute.

rules.title: Input VAT controls
rules.text: Deduct only tax attributable to eligible taxable activity under arts. 231–243. Keep paid import entries or separately stated regular invoices; a taxable supplier must give a VAT-liability certificate to a taxable customer, and without that certificate the customer cannot deduct. Read exclusions and mixed-use allocation before computing.
rules.quote: En l’absence d’attestation d’assujettissement à la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée
rules.assessment: Read 231-243: eligible activity, input documents, paid import tax, certificate requirement supported; 243(2) also reserves public/state-enterprise dispensing list to ministerial order. Clarify F 9.

rules.title: Returns, payment and deduction schedule
rules.text: File monthly, including a Néant return where no activity, and pay by the 15th of the following month. The return records turnover, taxable operations, eligible input and net tax, with signed/stamped purchase/import deduction details under art. 249. An omitted/incorrect deduction schedule causes disallowance that the text bars from later corrective/repeated deduction.
rules.quote: La déclaration d’un mois donné doit être déposée au plus tard, le 15 du mois suivant
rules.assessment: Read 249-254: monthly/nil, next 15 th, signed deduction detail and irreversible disallowance rule supported; not a verified portal.

rules.title: Credits and refunds
rules.text: Carry excess input tax forward under art. 244. Refunds are limited to art. 245 eligible cases, notably exporters and loss of taxable status, subject to art. 246: written request, at least MRU 100,000, three preceding credit returns and no current spot/general audit. Do not promise every credit a cash refund.
rules.quote: les trois dernières déclarations de taxe sur la valeur ajoutée soient créditrices
rules.assessment: Read 244-248: carryforward, limitedrefund categories, 100000, threecreditreturns, noaudit, request supported. No universal cash refund promised.

rules.title: Nil/credit return penalty
rules.text: A late nil/credit VAT return costs MRU 2,000 per month; MRU 10,000 where prior-year turnover exceeds MRU 30,000,000. Omissions/inaccuracies are separately covered by L.133 at 40% of compromised tax, rising to 80% where good faith cannot be accepted.
rules.quote: une amende de 2.000 MRU par mois
rules.assessment: Read L 131(2), L 133 with L 132 visually 158: 2000/10000 monthly forprior-year>30 m and 40/80 VAT shortfall penalties supported.

rules.title: Domestic permanent establishment
rules.text: A fixed place through which a nonresident carries on business is a PE. Construction/assembly and service projects require more than six months for ordinary businesses or more than twelve months for petroleum subcontractors/operators. Read fixed-place, agency, insurance and preparatory/auxiliary rules before applying a duration shortcut. Control of a company alone does not create a PE.
rules.quote: six (6) mois pour les autres
rules.assessment: Read 6(1)-(8): fixedplace, duration/control-alone statements supported but service PE needs personnel carrying on same/connected project in Mauritania. F 8.

rules.title: Nonresident service withholding
rules.text: Subject to treaty/special-code provisions, payments to a nonresident without a local PE for services furnished or used in Mauritania bear 15% withholding. The listed payers include real-regime businesses, government/public bodies, projects/programmes and NGOs/associations/foundations. The base includes ancillary amounts/costs paid for the provider.
rules.quote: Le taux de la retenue à la source est fixé à 15 %
rules.assessment: Read 132-133: nonresident/noPE, services furnished/used, eligible payer categories, 15%including ancillary costs and treaty/specific code reservations supported.

rules.title: Equipment, exchange and remittance
rules.text: Convert foreign-currency service payments at the rate on the payment date. Separately invoiced equipment sales within a service contract are excluded from service withholding. Remit monthly withholding by the next 15th; for an accrued unpaid service charge, pay within three months after year-end. Attach the annual supplier recap to the annual result return.
rules.quote: sous réserve que l’opération de vente soit facturée distinctement
rules.assessment: Read 133(3)-(7): payment-dateFX, separately-invoiced equipment, next 15 th, unpaidchargeswithin 3 months year-end, annualsupplierrecap supported.

rules.title: PE withholding interaction
rules.text: A nonresident continuing through a real local PE enters the ordinary regime. Withholding remains until filing/payment obligations are met; when they are met, withholding is a credit against the resulting tax. A fictitious local presence does not remove withholding.
rules.quote: ladite retenue constitue un crédit d’impôt imputable
rules.assessment: Read 133(9)-(11): realPE ordinary regime, withholding maintained until obligations met, credit, fictional presence supported.

rules.title: Dividends, interest and special capital gains
rules.text: Classify capital income under arts. 119–125, including exemptions in art. 122. Subject to treaties, IRCM is 10% in ordinary cases; the 20% exception concerns securities gains of a seller in a privileged-tax jurisdiction, not every dividend or interest payment.
rules.quote: 10 % dans tous les autres cas.
rules.assessment: Read 119-126: classification/exemptions, ordinary 10%and 20%privileged-jurisdiction securities-gain exception supported; no royalty blanket rate.

rules.title: Capital withholding calendar
rules.text: Withhold capital income on payment and remit by the 15th of January, April, July or October for the preceding quarter. Annual distributions/bénéficiaire statements are due before 1 April. Deemed PE distributions have the special quarter following annual-return filing rule; securities/mining disposals have their own rules.
rules.quote: au plus tard le 15 des mois de janvier, avril, juillet et octobre
rules.assessment: Read 124, 127-130 and visually 49: quarterly remittance andannual before 1 April/specialcases supported, but interest debit/credit trigger in 124(2) missing. F 5.

rules.title: Resident professional withholding
rules.text: Real-regime payers withhold 2.5% on qualifying resident liberal professionals subject to IBAPP, on invoiced tax-exclusive sums excluding disbursements. Remit by the next 15th. Credit to the professional’s IBAPP, carrying excess forward. This is not a general withholding on all resident suppliers.
rules.quote: à l’exception des débours.
rules.assessment: Read 131: residentliberalprofession IBAPP, 2.5%HTexcludingdisbursements, next 15 th, credit/carryforward supported; not all suppliers.

rules.title: Rent withholding
rules.text: Public/private legal persons and real-regime individual business taxpayers occupying premises withhold 18% of rent: 10% IRF plus 8% built-property contribution. Remit by the next 15th with landlord NIF/property/month details and give the landlord the tax receipt.
rules.quote: correspondant à 10 % au titre de l’impôt sur les revenus fonciers et à 8 %
rules.assessment: Read 137 with 136: occupying public/privatelegalpersons and realindividuals, 18%=10+8, following 15 th, landlorddetails/quittance supported.

rules.title: Withholding-agent liability
rules.text: A person required to withhold who fails or withholds too little is personally liable for the missing withholding and related penalties. Treaty relief must be demonstrated for the actual recipient/payment rather than assumed from nationality.
rules.quote: est personnellement redevable du montant de la retenue non effectuée
rules.assessment: Read L 139 and 126, 132: withholding-agent personal liability and actualtreaty reservation supported; no independent nationality exemption invented.

rules.title: Arm’s length adjustment
rules.text: CGI art. 40 compares connected businesses with independent conditions and adds indirectly shifted profits back. It covers links within Mauritania and abroad, with majority ownership, de facto decision power or common control. For privileged-tax-jurisdiction dealings under art. 23, a control link is not required.
rules.quote: Les bénéfices indirectement transférés sont déterminés par comparaison
rules.assessment: Read 23, 40 including 23 rd page: associateddomestic/foreign, majority/de facto/common control and privilegedregime no-control condition supported.

rules.title: Annual TP disclosure
rules.text: A Mauritanian legal person discloses annually if its tax-exclusive turnover or gross assets are at least MRU 30,000,000, or if it holds/is held by more than half the capital/votes of another entity meeting that test. Declaration under art. 65 is due with the art. 59 annual return. Do not treat it as the same obligation as keeping documentation or filing CbCR.
rules.quote: supérieur ou égal à trente millions (30.000.000) d’Ouguiya
rules.assessment: Read 65: own>=30 mturnover/assetsor indirect/direct>half linked entity atclose, annual 59 deadline supported; separate documentation/CbCR.

rules.title: Disclosure content
rules.text: The annual TP declaration describes group activity/policy/intangibles, the local activity, related transactions by amount/nature/counterparty/jurisdiction/method, related loans, no-cash/no-consideration dealings and foreign APAs/rulings on those transactions. Use the prescribed DGI format.
rules.quote: des informations sur les prêts et emprunts avec des personnes liées
rules.assessment: Read 65(2): group/local descriptions, TP/intangibles, counterparty-jurisdiction-method, loans, noncash/free dealings and foreignAPA/ruling content supported.

rules.title: Documentation perimeter after 2024
rules.text: The replacement art. 66 requires eligible Mauritanian legal persons to support transactions with associated enterprises in Mauritania or abroad. Eligibility uses own turnover/gross assets of at least MRU 30,000,000, or majority capital/vote ownership links to an entity meeting that test. This broadens the older foreign-transactions-only wording.
rules.article: LFI2024 art. 3.1 replacing CGI art. 66(1)–(2), physical pp. 7–8
rules.quote: établies en Mauritanie ou hors de Mauritanie
rules.assessment: Read LFI 2024 physical 7-8 right column: own/linked>=30 m, >halfshares/votes, domesticandforeigndocumentation scope supported; not a pricing-method hierarchy.

rules.title: Documentation readiness and cure
rules.text: Keep general group and specific local documentation, with content fixed by ministerial order, available when the on-site audit begins; it does not replace transaction evidence. If absent/partial, the written formal notice identifies missing items and gives 15 days to supply/complete. The revised text contains duplicated words and an inconsistent penalty cross-reference; use L.131(6) itself for the amount, not the art. 66 reference alone.
rules.article: LFI2024 replacement CGI art. 66(3)–(5), physical pp. 7–8
rules.quote: dans un délai de quinze (15) jours
rules.assessment: Read LFI 2024 physical 8 right visually: group/local docs, auditstartavailability, nottransactionevidence substitute, 15 dayformal cure supported; actual duplicated words and L 131(5) reference defect accurately flagged.

rules.title: CbCR ultimate-parent test after 2024
rules.text: Replacement art. 67 requires electronic CbCR within twelve months after year-end for a Mauritanian ultimate parent satisfying consolidation/control tests and prior-year tax-exclusive consolidated turnover of at least MRU 25,000,000,000. The old MRU 22 billion number in the 2023 code is superseded. Do not substitute a EUR 750 million threshold.
rules.article: LFI2024 replacement CGI art. 67(1), physical pp. 8–9
rules.quote: vingt-cinq milliards (25.000.000.000) Ouguiya
rules.assessment: Read LFI 2024 physical 8-9 right visually: 12 months, electronic, 25 bnpriorconsolidatedturnover, parentconsolidation/control tests supported; not 22 bn or 750 mEUR.

rules.title: CbCR local filing and substitution
rules.text: Replacement art. 67(2)–(5) adds local filing for specified foreign-parent nonfiling/nonexchange/systemic-failure situations. A non-ultimate local entity escapes via substitute filing only if all six listed conditions hold: similar filing law, automatic exchange agreement in force by due date, no notified systemic failure, actual exchange, reporting entity designation notified abroad, and local DGI notification of reporting identity/jurisdiction. Multiple eligible local entities can designate one with DGI notification.
rules.article: LFI2024 replacement CGI art. 67(2)–(5), physical pp. 9–11
rules.quote: sous réserve que les conditions cumulatives suivantes soient remplies
rules.assessment: Read LFI 2024 physical 9-11 right and visually 9-10: localfiling/triggers, sixcumulative substitutefiling conditions, localdesignationnotification supported. Actualexchange/list/currentimplementation remain holds.

rules.title: TP and CbCR penalties
rules.text: As amended in 2024, L.131(5) charges MRU 2,500,000 for late/missing, incomplete or inaccurate annual TP declarations. L.131(6) charges 0.5% of affected transactions per audited year after unanswered/incomplete formal notice, minimum MRU 500,000. L.131(7) charges MRU 4,000,000 for late/missing, incomplete or inaccurate CbCR. Do not add these automatically to an arm’s-length profit adjustment without identifying each breach.
rules.article: LFI2024 replacement LPF L.131(5)–(7), physical pp. 14–15
rules.quote: la production de manière incomplète ou inexacte
rules.assessment: Read LFI 2024 physical 14-15 right, 15 visually: 2.5 mdeclaration, 0.5%transactions/year>=500 kafterunanswered/partialnotice, 4 mCbCR incl incomplete/inaccurate supported.

rules.title: Entity choice and liability
rules.text: APIM offers individuals, companies including SARL/SA, branches and GIE. The central bank’s entrepreneur guide says an individual business has no separate legal personality/unlimited personal responsibility, while SARL liability is limited to contributions and its capital is freely set by members. Do not quote the old unsupported MRU 1,000,000 SARL minimum.
rules.article: APIM creation page; BCM entrepreneur guide, Types d’entreprises
rules.quote: Capital social : Capital librement fixé par les associés
rules.assessment: Read APIMcreation+BCMentrepreneur actualpages: forms, individualno separatepersonality/unlimitedliability, SARLlimited/freecapital supported; nottheold 1 mminimum.

rules.title: SARL membership
rules.text: The central bank’s entrepreneur guide gives SARL membership from one through fifty, with natural or legal persons. It does not establish a universal SA minimum total share capital; its SA statement concerns an amount per share, so the old MRU 5,000,000 figure remains unconfirmed.
rules.article: BCM entrepreneur guide, Société à responsabilité limitée
rules.quote: Nombre d’associés : Minimum 1 et Maximum 50
rules.assessment: Read BCM SARL/SAsections and independently reopened live page: one-to 50 natural/legal members; SA 500 MRUperSHAREnotuniversal totalcapital supported.

rules.title: APIM registrations and timing
rules.text: APIM’s Guichet Unique handles commercial-register, tax and social-security registrations. Its 48 working hours is conditional on submission of complete documents, not an unconditional end-to-end promise including bank/notarial/regulatory steps.
rules.quote: 48 heures ouvrables, sous réserve de la soumission de tous les documents complets.
rules.assessment: Read APIMoverview/registrations/FAQ: commercial, tax, social registrations and 48 workinghours onlyaftercompletefile supported.

rules.title: Common application dossier
rules.text: Prepare the completed/signed single form, valid founder identification/passports, address evidence, activity authorisation where needed, court-registry fee payment through the stated mobile-banking accounts and declared employee IDs where relevant. The site links Khidmaty for online creation and also permits the physical Guichet Unique.
rules.article: APIM creation page, Préparez votre application
rules.quote: Formulaire unique de création d’entreprise dûment rempli et signé
rules.assessment: Read APIMcommon/specific/FAQ: listed common inputs supported but companylocaladdress andforeignindividualmarriage-document conditions absent. F 4.

rules.title: Company-specific dossier
rules.text: APIM lists one certified copy plus three photocopies of statutes, the court-registry deposit certificate and capital-deposit proof or paid-capital declaration where capital exceeds MRU 10,000. Treat this document trigger as distinct from statutory minimum share capital.
rules.article: APIM creation page, Documents spécifiques/personne morale
rules.quote: Justificatif de dépôt de capital ou déclaration de capital libéré (si supérieur à 10 000 MRU)
rules.assessment: Read APIMcompanyspecific documents: onecertified+threephotocopies, statutesdeposit, capitalprooftrigger>10000 supported; notmincapital.

rules.title: Other legal forms
rules.text: APIM requires GIE agreement/member registry/statute/manager documents, and for a branch current parent registry extract, certified parent statutes where a legal person, plus certified branch-creation/manager-appointment decision. Obtain the actual form’s current checklist before submission.
rules.quote: Copie certifiée conforme de la décision de création de la succursale et de nomination de son directeur
rules.assessment: Read APIMGIE/branchlists: groupagreement/memberregistration/statute/manager andparentregistry/statutes/branchdecision supported; distinct individual dossier condition should be included under F 4.

rules.title: Published registry fees
rules.text: The government procedures page, last updated 17 October 2023, describes the service as free except court-registry fees of MRU 200 for individuals and MRU 500 for legal persons. These are the page’s dated published fees, not a verified 2026 full incorporation price or an amount including banking/notary charges.
rules.quote: 200 MRU pour les personnes physiques et 500 MRU pour les personnes morales
rules.assessment: Read entire procedure 790: updated 17 Oct 2023, servicefreeexcept 200 individual/500 legalregistryfees supported onlyasdatedpage, not 2026 quote.

rules.title: Completion documents
rules.text: The central bank procedure says pay court fees, receive a deposit receipt, then collect the commercial-register registration, tax identification number and CNSS affiliation. Reconcile legal name/address/manager across these documents and retain the submitted dossier and proof of payment.
rules.quote: Immatriculation au registre de commerce
rules.assessment: Read BCMsteps 2-4: application+courtfees+depositreceipt thenregistry/NIF/CNSS supported; documentreconciliation is prudent workflow notan invented legal obligation.

rules.title: 2026 initial financial tax/TTE changes
rules.text: The Ministry’s January 2026 text replaces CGI art. 278 financial-operations-tax rates and creates electronic-transaction tax under arts. 293 octies–terdecies. It is distinct from ordinary VAT. The exact promulgation/publication and within-year operation of the later rectifying text remain required before transaction advice.
rules.quote: Taxe sur les Transactions Électroniques (TTE)
rules.assessment: Read January 2026 selectedtaxtext: 278 replacement/TTE 293 octies-terdeciesandseparateVAT supported. Image physical 6 shows handwritten law 2026-001, missed by text extraction. F 7 updates evidence identity, no commencement inference.

rules.title: 2026 rectifying changes requiring commencement reconciliation
rules.text: The Ministry’s August 2026 publication contains replacement expense/NIF controls, digital-service place/liability/platform rules, a TTE cap, supplier reports and professional-account/audit rules. Its comparison columns are headed current provisions/proposed changes and its law-number field is blank. Keep this text in the amendment file; do not choose an operative date from its upload date.
rules.quote: Modifications envisagées
rules.assessment: Read LFR 2026 comparison sections for listed topics: replacementNIF/digital/TTEcap/reporting/accounts/audits supported. Image physical 6 shows 2026-035 andstamps, contradicting blank-number assertion. F 7.

rules.title: Corporate return fields
rules.text: DGI IMPRIME 20213611: A identification/regime; B profit/products; C1–C4 greatest profit/products/minimum; D1–D6 credits, D7 net tax, D8 carry; E1–E3 instalments and receipt details.
rules.quote: D-7 = C4  -  Somme (D1:D6)
rules.assessment: Read entire one-page IMPRIME 20213611: A/B/C/D/E fields, 2%/2.5%, normal 100000 footnote, D 7 subtraction, D 8 and E instalments supported; no live filing claim.
